Nia (Docs): quick heads-up 1 optimize toolkit docs failing typedoc on the quant examples. the TS snippet still uses the old 'quant_profile' shorthand and typedoc errors out.
Evan (SDK): ah yes, i saw that in staging logs. i'll swap the snippet to the new `quantization` object and add a tiny helper to keep examples readable.
Ravi (ML): if you change to `quantization: { preset: 'medium', dtype: 'int8' }` call out that runtime may override dtype based on target hardware. i'll add a one-line runtime note in PR.
Nia (Docs): also please update the python parity snippets and fix the sample link that points to `master` branch. small PR ok.
Evan (SDK): opening PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1299. changes: replace shorthand, add mapProfile helper, update py examples, fix link. adding sample-gen smoke test to ensure TS compiles.
CI Bot: docs-ci: typedoc error gone after patch. sample-gen: queued.
Nia (Docs): thanks! i'll run a grep for `quant_profile` and `profile:` after merge and open follow-ups if any leftovers.
Ravi (ML): adding perf note to PR: short sequences prefer int8; GPUs fallback to fp16 by default.
Evan (SDK): merged. closing thread.
